teach.text: Letters 21–24 of 28. Look at the dots: they are what tells many letters apart.

teach.name: qaaf
teach.sound: q (a deep 'k' from the back of the throat)
teach.note: Like ف but with two dots and a deeper tail.

teach.name: kaaf
teach.note: Has a small zigzag stroke inside, but no dots.

teach.name: laam
teach.note: A tall stem with a hook at the bottom.

teach.name: meem
teach.note: A small closed circle with a tail.
